column1: # The images of the Kubernetes VM Stack, read by mirror-images.sh (next to this file). Tab-separated, one image a line:
#   slug  release-tag  linux/amd64 image-manifest digest  aliases (comma-separated <name>:<tag> under the registry root, or -)
# mirror-images.sh copies each image by digest to ${LOCAL_REGISTRY}/readystack/<slug>:<release-tag> (the name the network
# and KubeVirt manifests use, pinned by digest there) and to each alias:
#   - kubeadm's names (controlplane/IMAGES.md): kubeadm-config.yaml sets imageRepository to the registry root
#     (${LOCAL_REGISTRY} = host[:port]), which is also where the node's containerd config looks for the sandbox image
#     (<registry>/pause:3.10.2); etcd.local.imageTag is v3.7.3, and CoreDNS keeps kubeadm's own tag, v1.14.2;
#   - KubeVirt's names (kubevirt/virt-operator, ...): virt-operator parses its registry from its own image name, and
# Each digest is the linux/amd64 image manifest this install bundle was tested with. mirror-images.sh copies a source
# (an OCI archive, or the release on Docker Hub) only when its linux/amd64 manifest is that digest, and refuses it
